title: Principal Pricing Program & Operations Manager (Remote Eligible)
description:
For over 20 years, Smartsheet has empowered teams to manage work seamlessly and scale solutions smarter. Now, in our most ambitious chapter yet, we are uniting human teams with AI agents. By orchestrating the work agents do best, automating manual tasks and uncovering insights at scale, we create the space for people to focus on what truly matters: judgment, creativity, and big thinking. That is magic at work, and it’s what we show up for every day.
 Smartsheet is looking for a Principal Pricing Program & Operations Manager to join our Pricing & Packaging team. This individual connects pricing strategy to execution. Our pricing analysts and strategists develop the research, analysis, and recommendations. You will take those recommendations and drive them to realization: building the plan, aligning the stakeholders, and landing the change across Product, Sales, Finance, Marketing, Legal, Billing, and Operations.
 You will work with guidance from the Sr. Director of Pricing & Packaging, but you will own the execution of your programs end to end. You will keep multiple initiatives moving at once, adapt quickly as priorities shift, and make sure that what we decide in the pricing team is what customers and the field actually experience. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong B2B SaaS pricing acumen with the discipline of a program and operations leader.  Program execution 
 Own the end-to-end execution of pricing and packaging initiatives, from the handoff of a recommendation through launch and post-launch measurement. Examples include new packaging constructs, list price changes, rate card updates, AI and new-capability monetization, and customer migrations.
 Build and manage detailed program plans, timelines, dependencies, risk registers, and RACI structures across multiple concurrent projects.
 Translate pricing recommendations into clear requirements and action plans for the teams that implement them, including Product, Engineering, Sales Ops, Finance, Billing, Legal, Marketing, and Customer Success.
 Run program cadences, including stand-ups, steering committees, and executive updates. Surface risks and decisions early, and escalate with clear options and trade-offs.
 Re-plan and re-prioritize quickly as business priorities, market conditions, and leadership direction change.
 Cross-functional leadership and communication 
 Build trusted partnerships across the organization and secure stakeholder buy-in, often without direct authority.
 Write clear, executive-ready documents, including program briefs, decision memos, launch plans, FAQs, and status reports.
 Present program status, outcomes, and recommendations to senior stakeholders and leadership.
 Partner with Sales Enablement and Marketing to develop field-facing materials such as pricing guides, discounting guidelines, talk tracks, and training, so that changes are understood and adopted.
 Pricing operations and governance 
 Operationalize pricing policy by partnering with the right cross-functional partners for critical changes to prices, discount guidelines, approval workflows, quoting and CPQ configuration, billing and systems changes, and exception handling.
 Contribute to pricing governance, including intake, prioritization, decision rights, approvals, and deal-desk escalation paths.
 Build repeatable playbooks, templates, and processes for pricing launches, migrations, and changes so the team can scale.
 Partner with Finance, Revenue Operations, and Business Systems to ensure pricing changes are accurately reflected in systems, reporting, and forecasts.
 Analytics and performance tracking 
 Define success metrics for each program and track post-launch performance, including ARR, NRR, ARPU, attach rate, price realization, discount levels, and migration performance.
 Use data to monitor adoption, identify issues, and recommend corrective actions or follow-on work.
 Work with the pricing team to understand the research, models, and assumptions behind each recommendation so you can execute with context and flag when results diverge from the plan.
 Support competitive pricing and packaging monitoring that informs ongoing program decisions.

 7 to 10+ years of experience in pricing, monetization, revenue operations, strategy and operations, program management, or a related commercial function, with at least 5 years in B2B SaaS pricing or monetization.

 Strong program and project management skills. You are skilled at managing complex, cross-functional initiatives with many dependencies and stakeholders. 
 Operations experience, such as pricing operations, deal desk, revenue operations, sales operations, or business operations, and familiarity with how pricing flows through quoting, billing, and finance systems.

title: EverPro - Director of Implementation, Service Fusion (Remote, US)

EverPro - Director of Implementation, Service Fusion 
 EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform, providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Our modern digital and mobile applications create predictable, informed, and convenient experiences between customers and their service professionals. Through EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell, we provide end-to-end business management software, embedded payment acceptance, marketing technology, and customer experience applications for the Home and Field Services, Health Services, and Wellness industries. Learn more at EverCommerce .com.
 We are building an extraordinary company and looking for talented, energetic, and motivated people to join our team. You can learn more about our company, culture, and values at evercommerce.com/about-us/careers.
 About the Role
 The EverPro Home Improvement solution group is seeking a Director of Implementation to lead the Service Fusion implementation team of Implementation Specialists and Onboarding Managers. You will own the new customer journey from signed contract to go-live on our field service management platform, partnering with our data team on data migration and integrations and reporting to the leader of our Implementation organization. 
 Your mandate is to make onboarding significantly faster, more scalable, and more digital, so customers reach value sooner and stay longer. You will also evolve the team's approach to helping customers rethink and improve how they run their business rather than simply teaching them which buttons to click — and make onboarding a continuation of the sales relationship rather than a handoff away from it. 
 What you'll do 
 Speed to Go-Live: Own go-lives and time to live for Service Fusion. Set and deliver an aggressive reduction target, and connect faster onboarding to lower early-life churn. 
 Scaled and AI-Assisted Onboarding: Lead build vs. buy decisions on self-serve and AI-assisted onboarding, backed by pilot data. Design tiered paths: assisted onboarding for higher-value accounts, scaled digital journeys for the rest. 
 Payments Activation: Make payments attach a standard stage of implementation, partnering with Sales and Payments to raise attach rates and shorten time-to-first-payment. 
 Team Leadership: Lead, coach, and develop the team, and partner with Talent Acquisition to manage capacity against new customer bookings. 
 Process, Metrics and Handoffs: Build implementation playbooks and stage-gate reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms. Own clean handoffs from Sales and to Customer Success, including an escalation path for blocked accounts. 
 Cross-Functional Partnership: Work with Product, Engineering, Payments, the data team, Customer Success, and Support so every customer launches with accurate configuration, clean data, working integrations, and trained users. 
 Remote-First Delivery Model: Build and continuously refine a scalable, primarily virtual delivery model suited to a small business pros. 
 Escalation Management: Serve as an executive point of escalation for at-risk implementations, working cross-functionally to get stalled implementations back on track. 
 What we're looking for 
 8+ years in implementation, onboarding, or professional services in B2B SaaS, including 5+ years managing people (ideally managers) 
 A track record leading high-volume SMB launches, with measurable reductions in time to live or time-to-value 
 Experience designing tiered onboarding and deploying self-serve, digital, or AI-assisted onboarding tools, including build vs. buy decisions backed by pilot data 
 A data-driven operator who has built onboarding stage-gates and reporting in CRM and onboarding platforms (for example,) 
 A strong coach who creates clear paths for growth 
 A clear communicator who resets expectations, handles escalations, and influences across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success 
 Preferred Qualifications 
 Experience with field service management software or SMB trades businesses (plumbing, HVAC, electrical) 
 Experience with embedded payments or fintech activation during onboarding 
 Familiarity with onboarding/CS tooling (e.g., Planhat, Salesforce and GuideCX or similar) 
 MBA or relevant advanced degree a plus 
 Where: US Remote 
 The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Jordan, New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are used to working remotely across different time zones. This role can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada – if you're close to one of our offices, we can set you up in-office or you can work 100% remotely. Please note that you must be eligible to work without sponsorship to qualify for this position, and this role may require travel to our Corporate Headquarters in Denver, Colorado, or to other office locations around North America.

title: Customer Success Executive (APAC & Middle East)
description:
Headquarters: Singapore, Singapore
 URL: https://alliants.com 
Our hotel partners across Asia are mid-shift while our UK team sleeps — and we're looking for a Customer Success Associate to be the in-region contact who picks up their questions and issues in their own time zone.
 The role at a glance Title: Customer Success Associate
 Location: Remote, based in Singapore (nearby APAC time zones considered), working mostly APAC hours
 Compensation: £35,000 – £37,000 per year
 Contract: 2-year contract
 Team: Customer Success (APAC & Middle East pod), reporting to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager
This is an associate-level customer success role on our APAC & Middle East team, and it's built around two things.
 You'll be our our in-region first response. When a property hits a problem overnight UK time, you pick it up, work with the hotel team and our in-region support, and hand the UK team a clear head start — rather than the hotel waiting for London to wake up.
 You'll own the day-to-day relationship with our standard properties across a region of more than 120 hotels and 13 brands. That means support follow-through, re-onboarding properties that need it, and making sure every hotel gets real value from our platform.
Enterprise and Growth accounts sit with the Enterprise Customer Success Manager. You'll shadow and support that work as you learn, and take on more over time; this role is the in-region contact for standard properties.
 Role Focus & Operating Context 
You'll communicate with hoteliers the way great hoteliers talk to their guests. Every message is written by you, with care. You'll work mostly in APAC hours, with some overlap into UK afternoons — more at the start. You'll sit in a small regional pod alongside Product Solutions, Support and Sales, with property teams from front office to GM as your day-to-day contacts.
 What you'll work on and own The overnight queue — what happens when a property's guest messaging stops at 2am in London and you're the one awake
 Standard property relationships — day-to-day contact with front office, guest relations, operations and GMs
 Re-onboarding — showing property teams how the platform works, how to configure it and how to escalate
 Adoption — playbooks rolled out property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites
 The regional read-out — a usage, adoption and support-trends dashboard reviewed monthly
 Clean records — accurate Salesforce data and product feedback routed to the right team
 What you'll bring 
 Guest-facing experience in luxury hotel operations — front office, guest relations, guest experience or rooms division
 Written and spoken English to luxury-hotel standard — you know how to write to a GM
 A real understanding of how a property runs, shift to shift
 Ownership — you take a problem from first message to resolution without being chased
 Comfort with simple reporting and data (spreadsheets, PMS or CRM reports)
 Confidence explaining technology to non-technical hotel teams
 Based in Singapore or a nearby APAC time zone, and able to contract with Alliants from there
 Availability to work mostly APAC hours, with some flexibility into UK afternoons
 Nice to have 
 Customer success, onboarding or account support experience at a hospitality technology company
 Hands-on use of Salesforce, Jira or Intercom
 Experience running training for hotel teams
 A regional language such as Mandarin, Arabic, Japanese, Bahasa or Thai
 To thrive in this role, you'll be someone who: 
 Asks questions before jumping to a fix, and finds the real problem
 Treats every hotelier like a valued guest
 Uses usage data and ticket trends, not anecdote, to decide where to focus
 Works confidently on your own and knows when to escalate
 Adapts naturally across the cultures of APAC and the Middle East
 Wants to understand how the technology works underneath
 You'll be the named, same-time-zone contact for standard properties across APAC and the Middle East.
 You'll pick up issues raised outside UK hours, work them with the property and in-region support, and hand the UK a clear head start.
 You'll own tickets from standard properties alongside Support, escalating to the Enterprise Customer Success Manager when needed.
 You'll re-onboard properties where gaps remain after deployment, so teams use the platform with confidence.
 You'll roll out adoption playbooks property by property, starting with the lowest-usage sites, and build localised guides and training.
 You'll shadow enterprise calls and pick up location-level work on Enterprise accounts as you learn.
 You'll track usage, adoption and support trends in a regional dashboard, with a monthly read-out.
 You'll flag at-risk properties early, so we keep the hotels we have.
 You'll keep Salesforce accurate for every property you support.
 You'll route product feedback and requests through Product Solutions intake.
 Who is Alliants and what do we do? 
Alliants, established in 2009, is dedicated to producing customer engagement technologies and services that pave the way for a more human, sustainable, and promising future for hospitality.
At Alliants, we are all in for our people and our industry.
 What's in it for you? 
We know we all work better in an autonomous, collaborative, diverse and equitable space. To support you in becoming the best version of yourself, we offer:
 Remote, in region: work remotely from Singapore, mostly in APAC hours
 Flexible hours: once you're settled in, a late day for the UK is balanced by a later start the next day
 Time to learn: around six months to learn the platform, including shadowing enterprise calls
 A regional team: work alongside our APAC & Middle East Customer Success and Product Solutions colleagues
 A warm welcome: to celebrate you joining Alliants, we'll plant a Great Oak tree in your honour
Alliants celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.
